services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: All Tackle and Bait is included with each trip and trust us -we have the very best in Tackle. No Saltwater Fishing License is required. We have a blanket license that covers everyone on board. We offer ALL types of trips including GULFSTREAM, Trolling, and Live Bait Trips. On our GULFSTREAM and trolling trips the boat is always moving and the anglers take turns reeling in the fish. On our Live Bait trips we will head out to some very productive wrecks and ledges and slow troll. Different species are targeted with each type of trip depending on the season. Fish Cleaning is included on all trolling trips. Trip Desired Offshore Trolling - 4 hoursOffshore Trolling - 8 hoursOffshore Trolling -

quotes.author: Payton Danti
quotes.text: I took my boys on a Sunday morning six hour fishing charter. It could not have been more amazing. Captain Bill and first mate Seth were fantastic. They were a wealth of knowledge and so supportive and made it so easy and so fun wish every day of my vacation could be that great. They were so accommodative and their ship was great and you would’ve thought the fish were working for them. This is my third charter by far our best one. I’d recommend this experience to anyone who wants to have a good time.

quotes.author: Drew Setchfield
quotes.text: From the initial conversation with Christy we knew we were in good hands. Christy explained everything we needed to know and followed up as needed to assure we were set. Bill and Jeff provided a morning of great fishing and relaxing boating. The 21 Spanish Mackarel we caught were expertly prepped for cooking. Our meal the evening after was perfect. Planning our full day trip for some time Fall or Winter and will definitely be planning around Hot Ticket’s availability.

quotes.author: Aaron Heisler
quotes.text: We could not have asked for a better fishing outing with our kids (4x ranging from 5 to 10 years old). Bill, his wife Kristie, and Seth made the entire trip a safe and fun experience. We landed 27 fish in our 4 hour trip. That was plenty to wear out all of our kids from the fun. Our next trip to this area will absolutely include another adventure on the Hot Ticket charter. Thanks again to Bill and his crew for the great trip!

quotes.author: Michael Chapman
quotes.text: The Hot Ticket Charter is exactly that! THE Hot Ticket! Great fishing. Great Crew! Awesome boat. We caught a ton of fish. The crew made it all possible Capt. Bill was fantastic at finding fish and the 1st mate was funny , informative, helpful and worked hard.. They filet all the fish when we returned after our 6 hr. trip. Looking forward to many more trips on the HOT TICKET!!

quotes.author: Anita
quotes.text: This trip was amazing!!! The crew went out of their way to make sure our family had a good time and caught lots of fish. My six year old son has not stopped talking about his adventure. Professional, out going, fun and accommodating! We will definitely book another trip when we return to the area. These hosts could not be topped.

quotes.author: Robert Krieghoff
quotes.text: Capt Bill and his first mate Jeff were terrific! We caught a lot of fish, which was super fun and the boat ride was just as enjoyable. We took our kids with us, and the guys were GREAT w/them. We’ve been coming to Carolina Beach for a number of years now, and this was easily one of the best experiences we’ve had here!
